offering_description.value: Owns and operates out-of-home advertising displays, including billboards, transit displays and digital screens. Sells advertising space to brands and agencies in the US and Canada. Displays sit on leased or franchised sites such as roadsides, subways, buses and rail stations.

primary_services.value: billboard advertising; transit advertising; digital display advertising; sponsorship and experiential advertising

customer_segment.value: B2B: advertisers, brands and advertising agencies

end_markets.value: advertising; media; retail; entertainment; consumer brands

revenue_model.value: advertising: fees from advertisers for display space on billboards, transit and digital displays

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: owns and operates billboards and transit displays on leased land and transit franchises, selling space to advertisers

geography_served.value: North America: United States, including major markets like New York, and Canada

specialization.value: related lines: billboards, transit advertising and digital displays

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: in-house sales teams selling to advertisers and agencies; agents / brokers: advertising agencies and media buyers; online: programmatic platforms for digital displays

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: billboard zoning and permitting by local and state governments, federal highway advertising rules
